summary: Re-sent merge request; prior reply didn't complete it.
detailed_context: Nick asked Jarvis to merge a PR and the release PR. The previous response was an analysis of the POC deployment that asked for a decision and made no merge. Nick then sent the same request again, which the rules treat as a repeated request. The first attempt also hit 529 Overloaded errors, so some of the repetition may come from the outage rather than dissatisfaction with the content. There is no explicit emotional language, so the signal is a clear miss on the task, not anger. To learn from this: when a merge is explicitly requested, proceed with the merge or state the specific blocker in one line, rather than returning an analysis with pending decisions.
